subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Cassie Chadwick's Bank Fraud
description: Learn Cassie Chadwick's Bank Fraud in one minute.

hook.text: Cassie Chadwick told bankers she was Andrew Carnegie's secret daughter — and borrowed millions.

buildup.text: She forged a promissory note and let a lawyer 'accidentally' see it in her purse.

discovery.text: Banks loaned her vast sums based on the assumed Carnegie connection. Nobody dared verify.

twist.text: Carnegie himself said he'd never heard of her. The banks collapsed trying to recover loans.

climax.text: She was convicted of fraud in 1905 and died in prison two years later.

punchline.text: A borrowed name can open vaults that bombs can't.

quiz.question: Whose name did Cassie Chadwick use to secure bank loans?
